name: guardian_preapproved
description: The narrow set of actions that may run without a person when an incident is in bypass mode. Everything else waits for approval.
data: {"_comment": "A class may run without a person only when all of these hold: the incident is in bypass mode; the command is require_approval in guardian_policy; it is not a destructive or credential-class action; its arguments satisfy the class constraints; and the command is also in the code-side auto-approve set of GuardianToolBridge. Editing this list alone cannot widen autonomy: that set must change too. Today there are two classes: xdr-endpoint-tag-add (tag values limited to a small set, reversible with xdr-endpoint-tag-remove) and GuardianContainmentSimulate (an inert test action that only writes a note).", "classes": [{"command": "xdr-endpoint-tag-add", "description": "Tag one or more Cortex XDR endpoints with a Guardian-controlled investigative label. Genuinely low-risk and fully reversible (xdr-endpoint-tag-remove); adds a label only, no containment/quarantine/execution effect.", "arg_constraints": {"endpoint_ids": {"required": true}, "tag": {"required": true, "allowed_values": ["guardian-auto-flagged", "guardian-suspicious-endpoint", "guardian-under-investigation"]}}}, {"command": "GuardianContainmentSimulate", "description": "DUMMY simulated endpoint isolation -- inert; records a sanitized note only, no real containment.", "arg_constraints": {"endpoint_id": {"required": true}, "reason": {"required": false}}}]}
